title: Mylos Steak & Grill set to arrive at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale
excerpt: Mylos Steak & Grill is set to open at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale, although further details about the new restaurant have yet to be announced.
body:
Mylos Steak & Grill is set to open at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale.

The restaurant is expected to become the latest food and drink business to arrive at the retail and leisure park, although no opening date, exact unit or further details have been announced publicly at this stage.

Rochdale Daily has checked the borough’s published planning information for evidence of an application specifically naming Mylos Steak & Grill. No application under that name was identified in the information currently available.

There has, however, been recent planning activity at Sandbrook Park. Rochdale Borough Council granted planning permission in August 2026 for changes to the former Pink Drips unit, including the reconfiguration of the site and alterations to create drive-through facilities. The published planning record does not identify Mylos as the occupier.

The planning position therefore does not currently confirm the new restaurant’s exact unit or opening arrangements. A change of restaurant operator or internal use may not necessarily require a new planning application, depending on the circumstances.

Rochdale Daily will update this story when further information about the Mylos Steak & Grill opening becomes available.

Source: Rochdale Borough Council planning register; information provided to Rochdale Daily.
